name: Bandarban
summary: Bangladesh's highest hills: cloud-level views, waterfalls, river canyons and indigenous villages. Best for adventurers and photographers.
season_note: October to March is clear and cool. Monsoon brings clouds and slippery roads; waterfalls are strongest then but some roads close.
avoid_note: Check current tourist permission and safety advice for Nilgiri, Nafakhum and remote treks before you go. Some routes require a local guide.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Sayedabad, Kamalapur) via Chattogram, 9 to 11 hours - Hanif, S Alam, Eagle
reach.note: Many people take a night coach and arrive at dawn.

reach.how: Fly to Cox's Bazar or Chattogram and continue by road

local.note: Standard way to reach the hill spots.

attractions.name: Nilgiri Hills
attractions.what: A high hilltop above the clouds with a view over the whole valley. Sunrise and sunset are famous.
attractions.tip: Check permission and current rules; go with a local guide.

attractions.name: Nafakhum Waterfall
attractions.what: A tall waterfall deep in the hills, reached by boat and a trek. Best from July to October.
attractions.tip: Hard trip. Needs a guide and a full day.

attractions.name: Shoilopropat Waterfall
attractions.what: An easy waterfall with a pool, popular for swimming.
attractions.tip: Go early to avoid the crowd. Watch slippery rocks.

attractions.name: Buddha Dhatu Jadi (Golden Temple)
attractions.what: The biggest Theravada Buddhist temple in the country, with gold-coloured buildings and a view over the town.

attractions.name: Meghla Tourism Complex and Sky View
attractions.what: A cable car, a viewpoint and a small park on a hill.
attractions.tip: Good as an easy first-day stop.

attractions.name: Boga Lake
attractions.what: A high natural lake in the hills, normally an overnight trek.
attractions.tip: Hard. Check access, take a guide.

attractions.name: Sangu River boat trip
attractions.what: A scenic boat ride between hills and bamboo villages.

attractions.name: Chimbuk Hill
attractions.what: An easier viewpoint hill with a famous sunrise and views over clouds.

rules: Take a local guide for remote treks.
Respect indigenous villages: ask before you take photos.
Check the latest permission rules before heading to remote hills.
